claim: On 2024-08-14 AWS Organizations began to support up to 10,000 member accounts in an organization, doubling the previous limit of 5,000 accounts; with a valid business need you can request a 10,000 account quota without service limit checks.
question: When did AWS Organizations raise the number of member accounts it supports in one organization to 10,000, and what was the previous limit?

qualifiers.condition: quota increase request with a valid business need

note: d008 d128. FRESHNESS hypothesis 5,000 -> 10,000 confirmed by the history row. The current quota page (organizations-max-accounts-default-10, organizations-max-accounts-increase-50000) gives a default of 10 accounts and increases up to 50,000; teach the current page, keep this row as history.
